# ONROL — AI Execution School

> ONROL is India's first AI Execution School: a Hyderabad-based, online-first AI education platform that turns students, working professionals, freelancers, creators, founders and developers into **AI builders**. The flagship is a **3-month live AI Generalist program** (build 5 real AI systems, no coding required), with an advanced **6-month AI Architect program**. ONROL teaches practical, project-based AI — no-code and low-code — across AI automation, AI agents, agentic workflows, RAG, AI chatbots, vibe coding, AI app development, AI content & video, generative AI, AI for digital marketing, SEO and more. Every module ships a real, deployable project; your portfolio replaces your resume. Flat, all-inclusive India pricing. Last updated: 2026-07-13.

## Flagship Programs

ONROL runs two core live programs. Both are online, English, ~1–2 hours/day, delivered on the ONROL LMS, project-based, and beginner-to-advanced by design.

### AI Generalist Program — "Your Roadmap to a Future-Proof AI Career"
- [AI Generalist Program](https://onrol.in/programs/ai-generalist/) — the canonical program page.
- [AI Generalist (overview)](https://onrol.in/ai-generalist/)
- **Format:** 3-month execution program · 50+ live sessions · build 5 real AI systems · no coding required (no-code + vibe coding).
- **Who it's for:** college students, working professionals, freelancers, content creators, teachers, marketers and founders who want to *do*, not just learn.
- **What you build:** AI automations (n8n), websites & AI apps (vibe coding with Lovable), AI agents (Relevance AI, Flowise), AI content & videos (Canva, Higgsfield), and AI chatbots (WhatsApp, website, Telegram).
- **5 modules:** AI Foundations + Prompting + Diffusion Models → Automation & Workflows → AI Agents & Agentic Workflows → Vibe Coding & App Development → Claude Ecosystem & Career Growth.
- **Tools:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gamma, Lovable, Canva, Higgsfield, n8n, Relevance AI, Flowise.
- **Includes:** 6 months LMS access, recordings, templates/prompts/workflow libraries, exclusive community, portfolio review, ONROL AI Generalist Certification + Builder Badge.
- **Best for:** beginners and career-focused learners who want a fast, practical path into applied AI.

### AI Architect Program — "Orchestrate. Connect. Deploy. Build End-to-End AI Systems"
- [AI Architect Program](https://onrol.in/programs/ai-architect/) — the canonical program page.
- **Format:** 250+ hours · 20 modules / 20 weeks of live sessions + 6 months of guided execution · low-code friendly · online.
- **Who it's for:** AI Generalist graduates, developers and technical learners, career switchers, working professionals and IT teams, freelancers and entrepreneurs, and ambitious students ready to build AI at a systems level.
- **What you build (15+ deployable projects):** full-stack AI applications, advanced RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) systems, multi-agent AI workflows, AI automation platforms (n8n), enterprise AI architecture blueprints, Android/desktop AI apps, AI content & lead-generation engines, and marketing-automation + analytics systems.
- **5 phases:** Technical Foundations (HTML/CSS/JS/React, Python, data, SQL, Power BI, statistics) → AI Core Skills (prompting, LLMs, RAG, diffusion, automation, chatbots, agents, MCP) → Build & Deploy (vibe coding, app development, deployment) → Advanced AI Systems (advanced RAG, AI system architecture, orchestration, production) → Growth, Marketing & Capstone (digital marketing, SEO, content, social media, paid ads).
- **Tools:** VS Code, Claude Code, Antigravity, Lovable, React, Python; Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Ollama, OpenRouter, Dify; n8n, Zapier, Make, Twilio; SQL, Power BI, Pandas, NumPy; GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, Firebase, Docker; Figma, Canva, Gamma, Runway, HeyGen, ElevenLabs.
- **Plus:** 5 bonus sessions (3D game generation, stack alternatives, AI SEO, Google ecosystem, Spline 3D) + 20 masterclasses.
- **Includes:** 1 year LMS access, recordings, exclusive community, personalized portfolio review, **AI Orchestrator Certification** + Builder Badge, placement assistance and career direction.
- **Best for:** people who already understand AI basics and want to design, connect and deploy real AI systems end-to-end.

> Pricing for both programs is flat and all-inclusive (no discounts, no upsells, no surprise charges). For current fees, cohort dates and brochures, contact ONROL or talk to a counsellor.

## Topics ONROL Teaches (keyword map)
No-code AI, low-code AI, AI automation, n8n automation, AI agents, agentic AI, multi-agent systems, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI chatbots (WhatsApp/website/Telegram), vibe coding, AI app development, full-stack AI, generative AI, prompt engineering, diffusion models, AI video editing & generation, AI content creation, AI for digital marketing, SEO & AI SEO, AI for business automation, AI orchestration, AI deployment (Vercel, GitHub, Docker, Supabase), Python for AI, data & analytics (SQL, Power BI).
